metadata.title: PhiGraph Core 4.0: A Shadow-First Evidence Ledger and Policy-Gated Runtime for Software-Agent Operations
metadata.description: PhiGraph Core 4.0.0 is a model-agnostic governance system for software-agent and AI operations. The paper describes its typed claim-evidence-policy-action protocol, scope-tagged tamper-evident ledger, policy-gated runtime, shadow-first deployment boundary, Python implementation, software verification, and an initial external anomaly-ranking experiment on CIC-IDS2017. Results are interpreted conservatively and include explicit implementation gaps and threats to validity.
